lines.speaker: Alice as Brienne Saltblade
lines.text: Brienne turns to the halfling: Pip, you've got the sharpest eyes of any of us. What do you make of that wreck out past the pier?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text:
Pip, Brienne’s looking to you for a keen-eyed take on that wreck. 

What do you do?

clips.name: Pip
clips.line: Honestly, the glare off the water beat my eyes today, so I couldn't make out much. I'd like to get closer before we swim out, and I can take the rope along so we have a way back up if it goes bad.
